headline: KMT's universal cash handout of NT$20,000 has a chance? Ye Yuan-chih says DPP has not opposed yet, but hurdles remain - Politics
summary: The KMT legislative caucus's special act for NT$20,000 universal cash handouts passed first reading in the Legislative Yuan. It still requires committee review and cross-party negotiation.
why: Large cash handouts are fiscal stimulus that affects government spending, public debt and consumer demand in Taiwan.
